## [1.5.0-dev.4](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0-dev.3...v1.5.0-dev.4) (2026-09-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Stop rating stars peeking out under the spoiler overlay ([4746d8d](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/4746d8d9c49edccc32a873f970555b5723f8c160))

patches.name: Brighter Watched-by stars
patches.description: Other people's star ratings in a film's "Watched by" row use a very dark grey (#445566) that is hard to read, especially on a black theme. This switches them to the lighter grey (#99AABB) the rest of the app already uses for other people's ratings. A small legibility fix, on by default.

patches.name: Denser poster grid
patches.description: Tightens the spacing around posters in grids so they render larger and closer together. Does not change the number of columns.

patches.name: Hide ratings until watched
patches.description: Hides the community rating (average + histogram) on a film's page until you have marked that film as watched, covering it with a tap-to-reveal control. The reveal is per visit — leave the film and come back and it is hidden again. Only the film page is affected; ratings shown in lists, search and elsewhere are unchanged.

options.description: How the hidden rating is covered. 'Frosted panel' is an opaque panel with a label; 'Tap-to-show link' is a plain text link under the section title; 'Shimmer' is a continuously animating particle field; 'Tap to burst' is a static particle field that scatters when tapped.

patches.name: Hide Video Store on home
patches.description: Removes the "Letterboxd Video Store" promo row from the Films tab. The Video Store itself, its settings and every other entry point are left untouched.

patches.name: Match bottom nav to top bar color
patches.description: Sets Letterboxd's bottom navigation bar background to the same color as the top bar (@color/black100), so it blends into the app's dark chrome instead of showing the default slate bar.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Repaints Letterboxd's dark chrome — window background, surfaces, cards, the top bar, tab strip and bottom nav. 'Wallpaper tint' follows the device's Material You palette on Android 12+ (no effect below). 'Pure black (OLED)' forces true black on any version. Optional accent colour recolours Letterboxd's green; optional bottom-nav selected style replaces the grey pill. No effect on Jetpack Compose screens. Overlaps "Match bottom nav to top bar color" — enable one, not both.

options.description: How the dark chrome is recoloured.

Recolours Letterboxd's green (stars, rating indicators, primary buttons). Pick a preset swatch or any custom colour. Letterboxd green is left untouched, except in OLED mode where it is brightened for contrast; lighter and darker shades for gradients and pressed states are derived automatically.
How the selected tab in the bottom navigation bar is shown. The green + button is never affected.
